# gen
# note names come out canonical and sorted, a header map having kept neither
# note the spelling nor the order the file had; the method and body come out as
# note the file writes them
>>> f.rr
-- a method and a url alone --
get https://example.com/items HTTP/1.1
-- headers and a json body --
post https://example.com/items HTTP/1.1
content-type: application/json
x-note: it's fine
accept: a
accept: b
x-empty:

{"name": "x"}
>>> stdout
# a method and a url alone
curl -X get https://example.com/items

# headers and a json body
curl -X post https://example.com/items \
  -H 'Accept: a' \
  -H 'Accept: b' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'X-Empty;' \
  -H 'X-Note: it'\''s fine' \
  --data-raw '{"name": "x"}'
